title: EV charging points in new housing estates and Tengah
asked: Dr Choo Pei Ling asked whether agencies coordinate to deploy EV charging infrastructure on time in new housing estates as towns fill up, and whether supporting infrastructure could be provided earlier upfront in newer towns such as Tengah as demand grows.
response: The Government targets 60,000 EV charging points by 2030 — 40,000 in public car parks and 20,000 in private premises — with 30,500 deployed as of March 2026. LTA monitors EV adoption and coordinates with the Energy Market Authority, HDB and JTC, and by end 2027 every HDB town will have at least one fast charging hub. In Tengah, two multi-storey car parks have chargers and LTA subsidiary EVe is deploying chargers in another eight. For BTOs that obtained TOP since last month, EVe now works with HDB to start deploying chargers from the point residents collect their keys.

key_points.point: Target of 60,000 EV charging points by 2030, split 40,000 public and 20,000 private
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: The Government targets to deploy 60,000 electric vehicle (EV) charging points by 2030, which comprise 40,000 in public car parks, and 20,000 in private premises.

key_points.point: 30,500 EV charging points deployed as of March 2026
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: As of March 2026, there are 30,500 EV charging points deployed in Singapore.

key_points.point: LTA coordinates with the Energy Market Authority, HDB and JTC on chargers and supporting infrastructure
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: coordinates with agencies such as the Energy Market Authority, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) and JTC to deploy EV charges and key supporting infrastructure

key_points.point: At least one fast charging hub in every HDB town by end 2027
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: By end 2027, there will also be at least one fast charging hub in every HDB town.

key_points.point: Two Tengah multi-storey car parks have EV chargers; EVe is deploying in another eight
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: Currently, two multi-storey car parks in Tengah have EV chargers, and LTA subsidiary, EV-Electric (EVe) Charging Pte Ltd, is in the process of deploying EV chargers in another eight multi-storey car parks in Tengah.

key_points.point: For BTOs with TOP since last month, EVe works with HDB to deploy chargers from when residents collect keys
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: starting from BTOs that obtained Temporary Occupation Permit (TOP) since last month, there is now a new arrangement, where LTA subsidiary EVe works closely with HDB to start deploying EV chargers from the point that residents start collecting their keys

key_points.point: For high-demand car parks, LTA will work with operators to add more chargers where electrical capacity allows
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: For car parks with high demand, LTA will work with EV charger operators to deploy more chargers, electrical capacity permitting.

How feedback from estates such as Tengah is operationally translated into changes in the planning and sequencing of EV charging deployment
supplementary: Feedback from Tengah residents and how it feeds into planning, sequencing and inter-agency coordination in newer estates.
